no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee meeting has been held in connection with this application.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened specifically for NDA203684 (Lumason/SonoVue); the CDTL review states plainly that 'No Advisory Committee meeting has been held in connection with this application,' and the Summary Review notes it 'was not presented to an advisory committee.' However, the drug's safety was reviewed as part of the ultrasound contrast agent class at the 2008 and 2011 Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee meetings, where concerns about rare serious cardiopulmonary reactions led to the boxed warning and labeling that Lumason carries. Because those class-wide meetings were not convened to act on this specific application, no application-specific AdComm-to-change linkages are recorded here.
